title: [EKA Fix] OutOfMemory Heap Error
body:
## [EKA] Automated Diagnosis
Approved by manager after partial confidence match.

### Proposed Fix
```
Increase container JVM allocation via -Xmx flag (e.g., -Xms512m -Xmx2048m -XX:+UseG1GC) and enable HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError.
```

### Citations
- Manager sign-off
